snippet.title: Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Thomas & Friends™: Wonders of Sodor is out now! https://bit.ly/Wonders-Of-Sodor-Launch-4
 
Discover and explore the Wonders of Sodor alongside Thomas the Tank Engine and his friends. 
 
Explore iconic Island of Sodor locations, experience 8 nostalgic stories and take the controls of 
Thomas the Tank Engine and his friends. 
 
Nintendo Switch and physical editions are coming soon. 

Buy now: https://bit.ly/Wonders-Of-Sodor-Launch-4
